scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names admin,user,server "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:user
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names admin,user,server "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:server"
scripts.start:admin: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=5030 NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-admin node server.js
scripts.start:user: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=5032 NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-user node server.js
